subject: I'm a Watson Roadster guy myself...
author: SUFFUR
body:
And in the days before anyone, could drive the PCPD, I could beat them because they would crash on those unknown corners, while i would just skim round, also, the Roadster fit's through traffic, to gain boostage a'la near miss etc.

Would you be interested in doing the rest of your blog for each class of car? Which is the best for racing anyway, since I don't really like the PCPD and have raced the Revenge Racer, to death in Revenge, The Hawker is a good one for 8?,9 and 10 boost classes too?

I also stick with stunt boost, since it is always there, and still not worked out what is so great about agression boost yet, I wonder if Criterion will 'tweak' it, as I think it is under used!

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
